exercise_nz.name: Exercise NZ Subsidised Gym Membership
exercise_nz.description: 40–70% subsidy for first-time gym members or anyone inactive for 12+ months. Available at 200+ NZ providers.
exercise_nz.eligibility: New members or those inactive for 12+ months
exercise_nz.note: Payment required upfront, subsidy applied at point of purchase through participating gyms

current_deals.title: Jetts 15% Off + 4 Weeks Free
current_deals.description: 15% off membership plus 4 weeks free on 12 or 18-month terms

current_deals.title: Snap Fitness 6 Weeks Free
current_deals.description: Up to 6 weeks free on 12-month memberships. AIA Vitality members also eligible.

current_deals.title: Les Mills Flexi Membership
current_deals.description: No lock-in contract flexi membership from $40/week. Join fee waiver deals available periodically.

current_deals.title: City Fitness $18.99/week Month-to-Month
current_deals.description: NZ's most affordable full-service gym chain. $18.99/week with no contract, $29 joining fee.

current_deals.title: Anytime Fitness 24/7 Access
current_deals.description: 63+ NZ locations, 24/7 access, reciprocal access to 5,000+ clubs worldwide. From ~$26/week.

current_deals.title: ClassPass First Month Discount
current_deals.description: Access 1,000+ NZ studios and gyms. First month heavily discounted for new members.

current_deals.title: F45 Free Trial Week
current_deals.description: Try any F45 studio free for one week. High-intensity group training, 45-minute sessions.

current_deals.title: YMCA Community Membership
current_deals.description: Sliding scale membership available for community members. Pool, gym, group classes included.

seasonal_notes.january: New Year rush — joining fees often waived. Best time to negotiate.
seasonal_notes.march_april: Post-summer lull — gyms actively competing. Good time to switch.
seasonal_notes.june_july: Mid-year deals common. Exercise NZ subsidy program very active.
seasonal_notes.october: Spring surge — check for free trial offers before committing.
seasonal_notes.year_round: Jetts and Snap regularly run 4-6 weeks free deals. Always check before joining at full price.
